labels.cachedReads: harness read cache (variant, not shipped): never verifier capacity
labels.asShipped: LedgerV4 as committed (ethers default batching, no staticNetwork), traced for counts
labels.postsAtConcurrency: POSTs per verification at c > 1 include ethers JSON-RPC batching across concurrent verifications in one worker
labels.latency: latency statistics use only items with the expected outcome (accepted for honest replies, the class's registered rejection for hostile replies); other items are error items
labels.replicas: each worker thread is an independent verifier replica with its own session store (sticky load balancing); exactly-once across replicas is not modelled
labels.network: loopback, same host (D-034); one local Anvil with automine; library-level calls, no HTTP front end

errorsAllHonest.note: honest replies not accepted (rejections, exceptions, timeouts) over every honest reply sent in measured ok blocks; duplicate copies excluded

aux.note: one value per worker (one honest reply outside the correctness batch, asShipped, c = 1, workers one at a time before the settle); recorded, not analysed as a series, not compared with Phase D cold

saturation.label: single timed run (n = 1): no distribution, no confidence interval

quiesce.cpuBasis: os.cpus() tick counters, 3 s window, all logical cores (guard.ts formula)
quiesce.thresholdBasis: cpuBusyPercent (machine-wide; own processes cannot be separated here)

guardTs.basis: guard.ts readQuiesce rule: cpuBusyPercent <= threshold (no process list on this platform, as guard.ts)

quiesce.processListBasis: not read on Windows (docs/BENCHMARK_POLICY.md host rule: the power query is the only Windows-specific call); foreign chain nodes only by the port probe

portProbe.basis: TCP connect to 127.0.0.1, 400 ms timeout (refused or no answer = closed); the runner's own ports excluded

quiesce.visibility: Windows host: no process list; CPU busy is machine-wide (includes the WSL2 VM and any other load); WSL2 listeners on 127.0.0.1 are seen through localhost forwarding when it is on.

saturation.fillTimed: VerifierV4.newRequest calls from the first to the refused one (process.hrtime.bigint())

memory.note: approximate: whole-process memory before and after the fill

saturation.openAfterOneConsume: opened (the accepted reply freed one slot)
saturation.openAfterTtl: opened; store size now 1 (expired sessions evicted)
